cards.headline: Example lab releases a faster open-weight reasoning model
cards.summary: Example Lab released an open-weight reasoning model that it says matches larger models on math and coding benchmarks while running twice as fast. The weights are available under a permissive license, and the company published a technical report describing its training data and evaluation methods.

cards.headline: Regulators publish draft rules for AI model transparency
cards.summary: A draft framework would require developers of large AI models to disclose training data sources and safety test results before release. Public comments are open for sixty days.
